# EconPapers

> EconPapers is a comprehensive open-access repository of economics research papers, journals, and academic resources powered by the RePEc network.

EconPapers aggregates working papers, peer-reviewed journal articles, books, and software from the Research Papers in Economics (RePEc) network. Maintained by Sune Karlsson at Örebro University Business School, it provides free access to economic research and connects economists through author registration and discovery services.

## Key Topics

- RePEc (Research Papers in Economics)
- Working papers

## Core Collections

- [EconPapers: Working Paper Series](https://econpapers.repec.org/paper): EconPapers working paper series directory and repository access
- [EconPapers: Journals](https://econpapers.repec.org/article): EconPapers journal directory with peer-reviewed economics publications
- [EconPapers: Books and Chapters](https://econpapers.repec.org/bookchap): EconPapers books and book chapters repository
- [EconPapers: Software Series](https://econpapers.repec.org/software): EconPapers software and computational tools for econometrics research

## Author Directory and Registration

- [EconPapers: Authors registered with RePEc](https://econpapers.repec.org/RAS): EconPapers economist author directory and RePEc Author Service
- [EconPapers: Persons registered with RePEc](https://econpapers.repec.org/RAS/defaultother.htm): EconPapers directory of unregistered persons and economist database

## Discovery and Alerts

- [EconPapers: New Economics Papers](https://econpapers.repec.org/scripts/nep.pf): New Economics Papers announcement and subscription service
- [EconPapers: JEL-codes](https://econpapers.repec.org/scripts/jelsearch.pf): JEL classification taxonomy search for economics papers

## Help and Documentation

- [EconPapers FAQ](https://econpapers.repec.org/FAQ.htm): EconPapers user FAQ covering search, downloads, and citations
- [EconPapers: About](https://econpapers.repec.org/about.htm): About EconPapers service by Sune Karlsson at Örebro University Business School
- [EconPapers: Archive Maintainers FAQ](https://econpapers.repec.org/archiveFAQ.htm): Archive maintainer guide for ReDIF, RePEc setup, and data submission

## Homepage

- [EconPapers](https://econpapers.repec.org): EconPapers homepage: economics research repository with working papers and journal articles
